generatedCommentsNodes.comment:
The javadoc on the new single-position `copyFrom` method in the template reads:
> *to know if you are copying {@link BytesRef}s so you can have the scratch.*
This text is copied verbatim into every generated type (Boolean, Double, Float, Int, Long), where `BytesRef` is irrelevant and the `@link` reference is misleading. Consider splitting the javadoc with a `$if(BytesRef)$` conditional so the BytesRef-specific sentence only appears in `BytesRefBlockBuilder`.

The template places `import org.apache.lucene.util.BytesRef;` in the `$else$` branch (i.e., for all **non**-BytesRef types), producing an unused import in `BooleanBlockBuilder`, `DoubleBlockBuilder`, `FloatBlockBuilder`, `IntBlockBuilder`, and `LongBlockBuilder`. This import is only needed in the BytesRef variant (where it's already present via the `$if(BytesRef)$` branch). It should be moved into the `$if(BytesRef)$` branch or removed entirely, since `BytesRefBlockBuilder` already imports it.
